content.text: Lays out its children in a column, or a row with `direction="row"`, with a `gap` between them: a number is in pixels, a string any CSS length. `align` positions the items across the stack (they stretch by default), `justify` along it, and `wrap` lets a row continue on the next line.
With `asChild` the stack lays out its single child element instead of rendering a div. `Stack` replaces the deprecated `HStack` and `VStack` of `alinea/ui`: `<Stack direction="row">` is an HStack.
